description: This is a modern sofa with a minimalist design. The base of the sofa appears to be made of wood, providing a natural and warm element. The seat is upholstered in a dark charcoal gray fabric, giving it a sleek and contemporary look.  The back of the sofa is defined by a substantial, light gray concrete-like structure, which adds an industrial or architectural touch.  It is adorned with three throw pillows in varying textures and patterns: one is a textured mustard yellow, another is a textured white or cream, and the third features a green leaf pattern, adding a touch of color and comfort.
